parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: The spout is the curved outlet of the faucet made of stainless steel, typically around 15 cm long.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the flow of water from the faucet to the sink.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Switch (Left Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left handle of the faucet, made of stainless steel, about 5 cm long.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the flow of hot water when turned.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis to open or close the water valve.

parts.name: Switch (Right Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right handle of the faucet, made of stainless steel, about 5 cm long.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the flow of cold water when turned.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis to open or close the water valve.

parts.name: Frame (Right Base)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right base frame of the faucet, made of stainless steel, about 4 cm in diameter.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the right handle and connects it to the internal valve system.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides structural support.

parts.name: Frame (Center Base)
parts.Basic_description: This is the central base frame of the faucet, made of stainless steel, about 4 cm in diameter.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the spout and connects it to the water supply lines.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Frame (Left Base)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left base frame of the faucet, made of stainless steel, about 4 cm in diameter.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the left handle and connects it to the internal valve system.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides structural support.
